title: Design Services Agreement
intro: This Agreement is made on 6 November 2026 between Blue Harbor Studio Ltd (the “Studio”) and Nordlicht Media GmbH (the “Client”) for the design of the Client’s new brand identity and website.
sections: The Studio will deliver a logo system, typography and colour guidelines, a twelve-page website design and a library of social media templates.
Work starts on 16 November 2026. First concepts are presented within three weeks; final files are delivered by 29 January 2027.
On full payment, all rights in the final designs pass to the Client. The Studio may show the work in its portfolio.
signTitle: Signed for and on behalf of the parties
note: Payment received with thanks. Bank transfer, ref. BH-2026-114.

letter.subject: Proposal: a new brand identity for Nordlicht Media
body: Thank you for a great conversation last week. As promised, here is our proposal for the new Nordlicht identity: a calmer logo system, a warm northern palette and a website that puts your documentaries first.
We suggest three stages, each ending with a review in Hamburg:
close: We would be delighted to start on 16 November. The agreement is attached and already signed on our side.
letter.name: Emma Clarke
letter.role: Managing Director, Blue Harbor Studio Ltd
